title: ballota russeliana
intro: Ballota russeliana, commonly known as Russian ballota or Russian wild marjoram, is a perennial plant species belonging to the mint family (Lamiaceae). This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, offering several health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties. The therapeutic actions of Ballota russeliana include pain relief, wound healing, and the treatment of respiratory disorders such as bronchitis and asthma. Its bioactive constituents include phenolic acids, terpenoids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
